title: Gëmkat bu nëbbu bi
intro: Ci biir néegu nguur gu mag gi, di barab bu gëmul ak jaay doole, benn baat buy wax dëgg, joge ci barab buñu xamul woon. Nit ki dafa doon ñaawlu kiliftéef gi ngir aar ndaw si, te dafay risk seen kaaraange ngir xamle dëgg gi.
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci réew mu bari jaay doole, di jaamu njiit luy wax ni boroomam la.
Maa ngi nëbb sama ngëm dëgg ay at yu bari, ndax dama ragaloon limu nara jur su ma ko fësalee.
Bu ndaw dikkée ànd ak firnde yu leer, damaa gëmoon, waaye samay nit ñoo ko pexe.
Ma taxaw ci kanamu jaay doole ji ak àttekat yi, di wax ni waru ñu ray ab ndaw bu deful dara.
Ma artu leen ci mbugalu xeet yu jëkk ya bañoon dëgg, mel ni waa Nóoyin ak waa Ad.
Allah muccal nama ci seeni pexe yu bon, ma seede yàqu-yàqu nguur guy noot.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Dafay xeex pexe yu ab luxuskat
Tabax ab tour ngir yegg ci asamaan si

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu muccal leen ci loraange, fekk ñuy yàq ñi leen di noot
Nekk na njiit lu am doole
Dañu ko sànni ci safara, mu génn te dara dalu ko
Doxantu na ci àll bi diiru ñeent-fukki at
outcome.answer: Ñu muccal leen ci loraange, fekk ñuy yàq ñi leen di noot

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
